description.value:
Whenever the white mage casts a spell with a casting time of 1 standard action, she may instead cast it as a full round action. The white mage channels some of the energy of the spell into a defensive shield around her, giving her a deflection bonus to her AC equal to the level of the spell being cast. This bonus lasts until the beginning of the white mage's next turn.

Asterisk talent: only one such talent's effect may be applied to an individual spell; decision made before casting.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
